name: Walt Disney Concert Hall
notes: Modelled in SketchUp (24 Sep 2026) and read back as meshes: the stainless-steel sails as closed curved sheets, each an arc in plan rising and curling outward at the top (cubic flare), their top edges tilting and bowing; ten petals round a low steel roof over the hall, the lower three curling out over the glass lobby at the entrance corner, and the drum as a petal curled into a ring. On a limestone podium with the stair on its east side. From the article's one exterior (the entrance corner at dusk) and general knowledge of the building; the plan, the backs of the sails and all heights (tallest ~46 m) are estimates, and the entrance corner is faced south-east rather than to the real street grid. Garden trees kept from the first version.
